analysis.one_line_summary: Static promo ad for WavyTalk Power Wave crimping iron offering 36% off plus an extra 10% off with promo code NV10.
analysis.full_description: A square graphic advertisement featuring the pastel pink WavyTalk Power Wave hair crimping iron displayed upright on a soft lavender gradient studio background. Diagonal pink ribbon banners at the top and bottom promote 'NOVEMBER DEALS • EXTRA 10% OFF • USE CODE NV10'. In the top right corner, a bright pink circular badge displays '36% OFF'. The right side of the image features the brand logo 'WAVYTALK', product title 'Power Wave Wave Hair Crimping Iron', and a call-out 'USE CODE: NV10' highlighted inside a vibrant pink pill-shaped box.

on_screen_text.text: EXTRA 10% OFF • USE CODE NV10 • NOVEMBER DEALS
Power Wave Wave Hair Crimping Iron
